BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to developmental screenings through the medicaidprogram; adding a new section to chapter 74.09 RCW; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that developmentalscreening of infants and young children is a costeffective method toidentify developmental delays early and provide appropriate services toreduce the negative impact of the developmental delay.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall adopt a rule specifying whichdevelopmental screening tools may be ordered for minors eligible formedical assistance. The rule shall also specify the frequency ofadministering these developmental screens. The developmental screeningtools and the frequency of administration shall be consistent withnationally accepted pediatric guidelines. (2) The department shall provide the appropriate committees of thesenate and house of representatives a report on the number and type of p. 1 HB 1337developmental screens conducted on minors eligible for medicalassistance and the subsequent services provided on December 1st ofevery oddnumbered year beginning in 2011.
